overrides.value: Cleans item fields from the right-click menu so that BibTeX exports are tidier: it replaces ";" with "and" between authors and removes "No." and "Vol." prefixes, with a preview and undo. It can also move filtered or duplicate attachments and notes to the trash.
overrides.reason: Translated from the introduction and feature list of README.md, which is in Chinese. The upstream has no English description: the manifest and the GitHub About text are in Chinese.
